All five plans pass scoped ruff format/check, ty, typelint and pytest; serial finalization passes the full offline gates and uv build.

constraints: Strict typing via tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no Any/object/dict, no **kwargs, no type-ignore; no weakening of the linters.
Raw detected values are never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned; tests assert raw samples are absent.
Default pytest is offline; integration tests are marked and skipped without TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL; offline-skipped integration tests are not risks (conventions 7a).
src/telescreen_police_sdk must not import telescreen.*; src/telescreen must not import telescreen_police_sdk (contract tests only).
No Python file reaches 1000 lines; plan files stay under 400 lines.
Fixed findings go only in addressedFeedback; findings and risks list only open issues (impl-plans/conventions.md section 7a).
No edits outside each plan's writePaths; reconciliation requests go to the Progress Log for serial finalization.
designDecisionsAndRationale: PoliceGateway methods take the DB session first, matching src/telescreen/ports/police.py, so transports participate in the caller's transaction.

Attempt is 0 at dispatch and +1 per claim or push POST, never on re-queue; max_attempts comes from PoliceTaskRequest (default 3) for both transports, which keeps retry semantics transport-independent.
The push HMAC key is signing_secret.encode('utf-8'), matching the SDK WebhookHandler(secret: bytes) and the n8n example.
Redactor every-string rejection returns 422 and leaves the task open, so a police can resubmit a clean result before the deadline.
No transaction is held across the push POST or the long-poll sleep.
intentionalTradeoffs: p11/p17/p21/p26 run bounded verify-and-fix checklists rather than re-implementation, to avoid churn on already reviewed code.
The p19 contract test imports the SDK only under tests/contract, so the decoupling holds at runtime.
supportedEdgeCases: Push replay (nonce reuse or stale timestamp) rejected; callback token is single-use (409 after acceptance).
Lease expiry re-queues without consuming an attempt; exhausted attempts and deadline expiry fail the police task.
Raw values in police results, notifications or sweep outputs are rejected or masked.
Map-reduce: 10,000-shard global max_concurrency cap, crash recovery without duplicate shards, 429 backpressure, reduce with removal reconciliation.
Slack integer file timestamps and thread replies with thread_ts.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Open residual risk (low): p19 does not raise the police_push_delivery engine TaskSpec.max_attempts (default 5) above the police max_attempts; harmless while no caller sets max_attempts above 3.
Open residual risk (low): handling of a sync 200 push body that fails the schema or Redactor relies on the engine retry path and the task deadline.
Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond the marked integration tests.
